issues.observation: Render: obvious granular noise across all three actual images obscures wall, liquid surface and stream detail.
issues.requested_change: Increase samples from 32 to 96 within the run budget. Reinspect all three rendered images at native size; keep denoising as a separately labeled output.

issues.observation: MaterialLighting: the lower liquid reads like a pale opaque sleeve in hero, with broad rectangular highlights in side, despite intended clear resin.
issues.requested_change: Reduce vessel/liquid roughness and darken the refraction card/ground. Preserve readable transmitted/refracted detail and a distinct free surface rather than a solid-looking fill.

issues.observation: MaterialLighting: the upper stream nearly disappears across part of the nozzle-to-vessel gap in hero and side.
issues.requested_change: Add a wider controlled stream-reflection strip and modestly increase the stream radius. Confirm a visible continuous edge or reflection from nozzle to impact in all three views.

summary: Actual hero, side and top pixels were inspected at 640x640. The vessel has visible rim/base thickness, the top view shows a free surface, and the metal witness and contact shadows read plausibly. However render grain obscures clear optical detail; broad pale card/reflection contributions make the lower resin resemble an opaque insert; and the upper stream nearly disappears in hero/side. The approved patch is a bounded look-development experiment, not a promise that every issue is solved. No photographic reference agreement, animation continuity, or A/C browser appearance was evaluated.
